title: bwrk operation stats: per-session self-audit command
description: Context: a 2h47m dabble-employee-app agent session made 300 CLI calls with 24 failures. Failure clusters: 117 read-only work show polls (~40% of all calls), 14 identical failed sync refresh retries, 6 vault init retries, 66 agent finish calls with only 2 standalone evidence records, 6 NOT_FOUND finish/release (ownership confusion), 1 CONFLICT claim, 2 POLICY_VIOLATION sprint closes. Design principle for this mission: every response (success or error) must carry enough state that the correct next action is derivable without another read, and the honest path (evidence, ownership, health) must be the path of least resistance. Problem: the session waste (polling ratio, failure clusters, retry loops) was only visible via a manual audit of the operation log. Change: add bwrk operation stats [--session <id>] --json that aggregates the existing operation records (already exposed via operation list/show) into: total calls, mutation vs read-only ratio, per-command counts, failure clusters grouped by command+error code, and consecutive-identical-failure runs. Where: alongside the existing operation list/show/prune handlers in apps/cli/src/commands.ts, registered in command-registry.ts, documented in docs/cli/COMMANDS.md. This feeds later doctor visibility (sprint H2 tasks) but must work standalone. Constraint: read-only; must run against the operation log even when workspace health is degraded.
acceptanceCriteria: operation stats --json reports totals, read/mutation ratio, per-command counts, failure clusters, and longest consecutive-identical-failure run
Command is read-only and succeeds even when sync/vault health checks fail
